tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skabs lnga ba drug pa bdun pa gsum gyi ṭīk+ka mthong ba don yod ces bya ba bzhugs/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ rgyu mtshan dang*/ gzhung don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bshad zin pa'i 'og tu rtse sbyor 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la goms pa dbang bsgyur ma thob pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bsgoms pa la brten nas de thob pa'i rtse sbyor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar yang 'grel pa las/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa thob pa rab kyi mthar phyin pa'i rtogs pa 'byung bas/ zhes pa nas/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa dang*/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi/ dang po la/ bzhi las/ dang po drod ni/ rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu bzhed/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ gnyis pa rtse mo ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo snyed/ /zhes pa nas/ rnam 'phel bcu drug bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ gsum pa bzod pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid gsum chos rnams kyi nas/ brtan pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ bzhi pa chos mchog ni/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dag dang*/ /nas/ ting 'dzin yongs su bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ dang po'i don ni/ drod rjes thob la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon chos can/ drod rtse sbyor thob pa yin te/ bsgoms stobs kyis nyin par ma zad rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun bden stong rmi lam lta bur lta ba la sogs pa'i rtse mor byin pa'i sbyor ba thob pa'i rtags rnam pa bcu gnyis dag tu mdo las bzhed pa ste bshad pa de dag dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbyor lam rtse mo la gnas pa'i sems dpa' dbang rnon chos can/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor thob pa yin te/

mdo las 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo la sogs pa stong gsum kyi sems can gyi grangs gyi sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge ba la sogs pa rnam pa mang du ni dper mdzad nas bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba bcu drug gi bdag nyid thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa chos can/ khyod la brtan pa'i rtse sbyor zhes pa ni yum gyi mdo las mngon par brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi shes la sogs pa'i kun mkhyen nyid gsum gyi chos rnams kyi rtogs rigs yongs su rdzogs pa bla na med pa thob cing sems can gyi don byed pa yongs su mi gtong ba thob pa'i theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha 'thun gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can chos can/ khyod mdo las ting nge 'dzin ces yong su bsgrags pa yin te/ gling bzhi pa dang stong dang po dag dang stong gnyis pa dang stong gsum gyi sa dag srang grangs gyis gzhal pa dang chu skra rtses gzhal nus pa dper mdzad nas/ de bas kyang sems dang po bskyed pa spyod pa la zhugs pa phyir mi ldog pa skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems kyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i bsod nams mang po nyid kyis ni mtshon te bstan pa'i theg chen gyi nges cha bzhi pa yin pa'i phyir/ drod rtse sbyor gyi rtags bcu gnyis yod de/ rmi lam du chos thams cad bden med rmi lam ci 'dra de lta bur lta ba dang*/ rmi lam du dman pa'i lam la dga' ba mi bskyed pa dang*/ rmi lam du de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor bcas mthong ba dang*/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyis rdzu 'phrul ston pa mthong ba dang*/ des chos ston pa mthong ba dang*/ ngan song mthong nas spong pa'i smon pa byed pa dang*/ rmi sad gang rung la grong khyer sogs mes 'tshig pa mthong nas bden pa'i byin gyis de dag zhi bar byed nus pa dang*/

rmi sad gang rung gi tshe sems can gzhan mi ma yin gyis zin pa bden stobs brjod pas zhi nus pa dang*/ bdud las shes nas de zil gyis gnon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ sher phyin la slob pa dang*/ chos thams cad la bden par mi zhen pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sar nye bar gyur pa'i ye shes thob pa dang bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rtse mo'i rtags bcu drug yod de/ stong gsum gyi sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i bsod nams las lhag pa thob pa dang*/ de gong du 'phel bas sher phyin yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ stong nyid la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa thob pa dang*/ byang chub thob byed kyi lam don dam par mi dmigs pa dang*/ dge ba bcu dang bsam gtan gzugs med la snyom par 'jug pa dang*/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha 'ongs nas srung ba dang*/ bdud zil gyis gnon nus pa dang*/ byang sems dang grogs gcig par bslab pa ste phyi'i rtags gtso bor gyur pa brgyad dang*/ nyan rang yid byed dang bral ba'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs khyad par can du gyur pa dang*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu nus ldan 'grub pa dang*/ phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs ser sna sogs cher mi skye ba dang*/ chos rnams la bden zhen ci rigs mi skye ba dang*/ sher phyin gyis phyin drug la slob tshul shes pa dang*/ theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang*/ sher phyin gyi mthus rdzogs byang la nye ba thob pa ste nang gi rtags brgyad dang bcu drug yod pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i rtags yod de/ gzhan don khyad par can sgrub nus pa'i thabs kyis zin pa'i snying rje chen po dang*/ bsgom byung gi shes rab kyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs shes kyi rtogs pa brtan po de de yin pa'i phyir/ chos mchog rtse sbyor thob pa'i rtags yod de/ mdo las bsod nams mang po 'byung bas mtshon te bstan pa de lta bus shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa mthong lam rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ spang bya rtogs pa dang*/ gnyen po rtse sbyor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung rtog dang*/ 'dzin rtog gnyis las dang po ni/ 'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la/ /nas/ min pa'i bdag nyid dag shes bya/ / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen mthong lam gyi spang bya 'jug pa gzung rtog dang ni ldog pa la gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis chos can/ so sor dgu dgu'i bdag nyid du shes par bya ste/ dmigs yul gyi sgo nas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ ji lta ba bzhin du yul gyi rang bzhin 'dzin pa ma yin pa'i bdag nyid dag tu shes par bya ste/ rang gi zhen yul la phyin ci log tu 'khrul pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ so so skye bo 'phags dbye bas/ /nas/ ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i rten dbye bas sems can rdzas yod dang skyes bu btags par yod par bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'dzin pa dag tu 'dod pa de dag chos can/ so sor dgu'i bdag nyid du 'dod de/ dmigs yul gyi sgo nas de ltar 'byed pa'i phyir/ rtog pa de dag chos can/ gnas tshod dang mthun par yul gang gis 'dzin par 'dod pa mi rigs te/ rgyu mtshan gal te 'am gang gi phyir na gzung ba'i don de bzhin med pa'i log shes yin pa'i phyir te/ de la rtog pa de dag rang gi ji ltar 'dzin pa yi ngo bos stong pa'i mtshan nyin can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas bar bshad pa la/ gzung rtog dang*/ 'dzin rtog bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ gzung rtog 'dzin rtog gnyis las/ dang po la/ ngo bo nyid dang rigs dang ni/ /nas/ rnam rtog de ni rnam dgur 'dod/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs*/ don ni/ byang sems kyi 'jug pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi rnam rtog de ni chos can/ rnam pa dgur 'dod pa yin te/

byang sems kyi 'jug bya spyi'i ngo bo nyid la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par zhen pa dang*/ de bzhin du sbyar te bye brag sangs rgyas kyi rigs nges pa dang*/ byang chen kyi lam ni yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ blo'i shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul ba dang mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus shing gnyen po skye ba dang*/ rang gi rtogs pa mthar thug pa dang*/ gzhan kyi don byed nus pa dang*/ gzhan don de'i ni las su bya ba dang*/ de'i bya ba'i 'bras bu la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srid dang zhi bar ltung pa'i phyir/ nas/ nyan thos la sogs yid las 'byung*/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes sgrib ldog pa gzung rtog zhes pa'i phyogs kyi rten can gyi te nyan thos la sogs pa'i yid la 'byung ba dman pa'i lam la ltos pa'i ldog byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di chos can/ rnam pa dgu yi bdag nyid du yod de/ srid pa dang zhi bar ltung pa'i phyir na theg chen las rtog pa dman pa nyid la dmigs nas ldog byar bden par zhen pa dang*/ de bzhin du lam khyad par can gyis yongs su 'dzin pa med pa la dmigs pa dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i lam gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba la dmigs pa dang*/ thar par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba la dmigs pa dang*/ ched du bya ba chen po gsum las log pa la dmigs pa dang*/ spang pa nyi tshe ba'i lam la dmigs pa dang rtogs pa mtho dman sna tshogs pa nyid dang*/ zhi mtha' mngon du ma byas par theg chen gyi lam la gnas pa dang der 'jug pa la rmongs pa'i lam la dmigs pa dang*/ zhi mtha' mngon du byas pa'i rjes la rnam mkhyen du 'gro ba zhes bya ba la dmigs nas ldog byar bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gzung rtog gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ byang sems lam gyi 'jug bya'i chos la dmigs nas de'i 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin de la 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/

de la ltos pa'i ldog bya'i chos la dmigs nas de'i ldog byar bden par 'dzin de la ldog pa gzung rtog tu bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa'i dgos pa yod de/ byang sems kyis 'jug par bya ba blang bya dang*/ ldog par bya ba spang bya'i chos gang la'ang bden par mi 'dzin cing*/ bden med du rtogs nas bsgom par bya dgos so zhes go ba'i ched du yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dzin rtog rgyas par bshad pa la/ /rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ rtag 'dzin rtog pa'i dbye ba bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dzin pa dang ni 'dor ba dang*/ /nas/ 'dzin pa dang por shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ 'dzin pa dang po rjas 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ khyod la rnam pa dgu yod par shes par bya ste/ kun rdzob tu yon tan 'dzin pa dang skyon 'dor ba'i gang zag la dmigs nas bden par 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin du gang zag la zhes sbyar te gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci log tu yid la byed pa la dmigs pa dang*/ bden 'dzin gyi khams ni 'dod khams sogs gsum po dag dang nye bar 'brel ba la dang*/ chos rnams bden par bzung nas gnas pa la dang*/ de la bden med du bden par mngon par zhen pa dang*/ chos thams cad tha snyad du chos kyi dngos po tsam du btags pa la dang*/ mi mthun phyogs la bden par chags pa dang*/ bden 'dzin gyi gnyen po sgom pa la dang*/ rnam mkhyen du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin myur du 'gro ba las nyams pa'i gang zag la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par zhen pa'i rnam rtog dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung dang*/ /nas/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gzhan btags 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ rnam pa dgu yod pa yin te/ ched du bya bar ji lta ba bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba'i skyes bu btags yod la dmigs nas bden par zhen pa dang*/

de bzhin du lam min drug la lam ma yin par nges par 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la dmigs pa dang*/ rgyu 'gag pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras bu skye bar zhen pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ bden 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i lam gyi dngos po ldan pa dang*/ bcings pa'i lam gyi dngos po mi ldan par 'dzin pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ gzung rtog la bden par zhen te gnas pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ theg dman gyi rigs ni 'jig cing nyams par byed pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ rdzogs byang don du gnyer ba med pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ rgyu sher phyin sgom pa med pa'i skyes bu la dang*/ bdud sogs phyir rgol ba ni dmigs pa'i skyes bu btags yod la longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ 'dzin rtog 'di gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ rdzas yod rdzas 'dzin gyi chos la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin la rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags yod btags 'dzin la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin la btags 'dzin rtog par bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan ni kun btags kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi spang bya 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir gzung rten 'dzin rtog gnyis ni bden 'dzin la 'jog par mtshungs kyang khyad par yod de/ gzung rtog gnyis yul la zhen pa dang*/ 'dzin rtog gnyis yul can la zhen pa gtso ba'i dbang du mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir te/ snga ma gnyis yul la longs spyad bya dang phyi ma gnyis yul can la longs spyod pa por zhen pa'i khyad par gyis yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gnyen po rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi rgyu/ de'i 'bras bu byang chen/ rtse sbyor gyi ngo bo bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ byang chub la gzhan ston pa dang*/ nas/ bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyin do/

/zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi rigs can gzhan byang chub la ston pa ste/ 'god pa dang*/ byang chub de yi rgyu sher phyin gyi tshig don ni yongs su gtod pa ste 'chad pa dang*/ byang chen de thob byed bsod nams mang po'i mtshan nyid can gyi theg chen gyi sbyor lam mnyam bzhag ye shes chos can/ khyod mthong lam rtse sbyor gy-i bar chad med pa'i rgyu yin te/ de bar chad med par skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ byang chen ngos bzung ba/ dngos po bden grub du khas len pa'i mi 'thad pa/ dbu ma pas chos thams cad bden stong du khas len dgos par bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i/ /nas/ go rim bzhin du shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ byang chub chen po yin ces brjod de/ dri ma don dam par zad pa med pa dang mi skye bar rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir te/ de ltar rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes de dag go rim bzhin du zad mi skye shes pa'i byang chub chen por shes par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ dri ma de yang chos can/ don dam par zad med skye med yin te/ don dam par grub pa med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ lung dang 'gal ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /nas/ skye med rnam pa ci zhig 'thob/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni chos can/ shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rigs bden grub sngar yod ci zhig zad cing*/ de bden grub skye 'phro chad pa'i skye med kyi rnam pa ci zhig kyang 'thob ste 'thob pa med par thal/ dri ma bden grub sngar yod gsar du 'gags pa'i 'gog pa med pa ste/ spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ /nas/ de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/

/zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ dngos smra ba gzhan gyi lugs la phyi nang gi chos rnams kyang don dam par yod la/ shes bya la yang rmongs pa'i sgrib pa mtha' dag ston pa yis zad par brjod pa gang yin pa'i dngos smra ba'i lugs de la byams pa kho bos ngo mtshar du brtsis pa la chos can/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgrib pa bden par grub na gnyen pos spang du mi rung bas de ltar 'dod pa de gzhad gad kyi gnas yin par rtogs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /nas/ yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ shes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ khams rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa 'di la chos can/ gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis sngar yod gsar du bsal bar bya ba dang*/ bdag 'dzin gnyis don dam par grub pa ci yang med de/ bdag 'dzin gnyis zhen yul dang bcas pa don dam par grub ma myong pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ bdag med gnyis sngar med par gsar du bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang med de/ bdag gnyis gdod nas ma grub pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu mtshan des na/ rten 'brel bden par med pa'i yang dag pa'i don nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag bar lta ba yin te yang dag pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du mthong nas yang yang goms par byas pas mthong pa po sgrib gnyis las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'di'i don go bde bar bshad na 'di ltar yin te/ chos thams cad grub tsam nyid nas bden par med pa yin gyi bden grub de nyid sngar yod lung rigs sogs kyis gsar du med par byas pa min cing*/ bden stong de yang sngar med gsar du lung rigs sogs kyis bzhag pa ma yin pas/ yang dag pa'i don gyi gnas lugs sngar yod la der ngo shes par byas nas grol bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ 'dis dbu ma'i lugs kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum bstan pa yin te/

gzugs sogs bden stong gzhi/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes lam/ ngo bo nyid sku lta bu 'bras bu dbu mar bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la/ dngos dang*/ spangs pa la dbang byed pa gnyis*/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni/ /nas/ bsdus ba de 'dir mthong pa'i lam/ / zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i ngo bo re rer ni sbyin sogs de dag phan tshun bsngags pa gang yin pa skad cig gcig pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes pa'i bzod pa yis bsdus pa'i theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam chos can/ skabs 'dir mthong ba'i lam gyi rtse sbyor yin te/ mthong spang shes sgrib dngos su 'jom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi bden pa mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas sed+ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /nas/ lugs mi mthun la rtogs par byed/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ bshad zin pa de nas mthong lam rtse sbyong la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chos can/ rang gi spangs pa la dbang byed pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan te/ mnyam bzhag tu sed+ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dus phyis rjes thob tu rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis kyi lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun la rtogs par byed pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sed+ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam grol lam las langs rjes su ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed 'byung ba nas skye ba'i rkyen kyis rga shi 'byung ba'i bar nyon mongs phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mthun dang ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gags pa nas skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mthun dang*/ yang rga shi skye ba las 'byung ba nas 'du byed ma rig pa las 'byung ba'i bar nyon mongs phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mi mthun dang*/ rga shi 'gags pas ma rig pa 'gags pa'i bar rnam byang phyogs kyi rten 'brel lugs mi mthun du rtog pa'i phyir ro/

/gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ gnyen po sgom lam/ spang bya rtog pa/ de spangs pa'i phan yon gsum/ dang po ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ /nas/ 'gog pa'i bar du mi 'drar 'gro/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ sa brgyad pa pa'i rgyud kyi sed+ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi snyoms 'jug chos can thod rgal gyi sbyor ba yin te/ thod rgal gyi dngos gzhi dngos 'gro 'gog pa dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu po'i bar dag tu/ gang yang ma bcug par lugs mthun dang lugs mi mthun rnam pa gnyis su yar song zhing mar 'ongs nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i mngon rtogs mdor bshad pa de yin pa'i phyir/ sa brgyad pa pa'i rgyud kyi mnyam bzhag ma yin pa'i 'dod par gtogs pa'i las bsdus pa'i rnam par shes pas sa mtshams gzung ste bar la 'dod sems spel ba'i snyoms 'jug de chos can/ thod rgal du ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi yin te/ sbyor ba sed+ge rnam bsgyings sngon du btang nas dang por 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug /de las langs nas 'dod sems mngon du byed/ de nas 'gog pa gcig pu brgal nas srid rtse dang*/ de nas 'dod sems/ de nas 'gog pa dang srid rtse gnyis brgal nas ci yang med dang*/ de nas yang 'dod sems/ de ltar de gsum brgal nas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ de nas 'dod sems/ de ltar bzhi brgal nas nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ yang 'dod sems/ de ltar lnga brgal nas bsam gtan bzhi pa dang*/ yang 'dod sems/ de ltar drug brgal nas bsam gtan gsum pa dang*/ yang 'dod sems/ de ltar bdun brgal nas bsam gtan gnyis pa dang*/ yang 'dod sems/ de ltar brgyad brgal nas bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug cing*/ de las langs nas 'dod sems mngon du byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin de chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi rang bzhin thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug zhes bya ste/

'gog pa dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu'i bar du 'dod sems spel te/ spel gzhi dang spel chos mi 'dra bar spel nas 'gro ba'i theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir te/ spel gzhi mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu la spel chos 'dod sems spel nas snyoms par 'jug pa'i snyoms 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ de ni dngos bstan yin la/ de'i shugs kyis gang bstan pa yang yod de/ bar du gang yang ma grub pa'i yar song gcig dang*/ mar 'ongs bsam gzugs brgyad la 'gog pa spel ba gnyis don gyis bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sbang bya rtog pa la/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/ ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /nas/ sbyor pa'i rnam pa'i spyod yum can/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ gnyen po sbyong ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can spang bya shes sgrib 'jug pa gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa 'di chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ mdor bsdus pa'i gsung rab brjod bya dang bcas pa la/ dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par zhen pa dang*/ de bzhin du gsung rab rgyas pa'i brjod bya ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bsrung bas te grogs kyis yongs su ma bzung ba'i gnyen po sher phyin ma dang*/ 'das pa sbyor lam dang da lta ba mthong lam dang ma 'ongs pa sgom lam ste dus gsum kyi yon tan don dam par med kyang tha snyad du yod pa la dmigs pa dus la ltos pa gsum dang*/ legs pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ni sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam sgom pa'i lam rnam pa gsum gyi ngo bo la dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gsum dang bcas pa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams/ /nas/ sgom pa'i lam la shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sgom pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa'i sems dang sems byung 'jug pa'i yul can bar chad med lam rnams kyis spong bar yin par bzhed pa'i gnyis pa shes sgrib ldog pa gzung rtog chos can/

khyod la dgu yod par shes par bya ste/ re zhig byang chub kyi sems mi skye ba la dmigs nas ldog byar bden par zhen pa dang*/ de bzhin du byang chub kyi snying po chos sku yid la mi byed pa la dang*/ nyan rang gi theg pa dman pa yid la byed pa gnyis la dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub yid la mi byed pa la dang*/ lam sher phyin gyi gzugs brnyan sgom pa la dang*/ stong nyid phra mo sgom pa med pa la dang*/ sgom dang sgom pa med pa de dag las ni bzlog pa sgom min pa nyid la dmigs pa gnyis pa dang*/ gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin gyi don ma yin pa rnams la dmigs nas ldog byar bden par rnam par rtog pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ btags 'dzin rtogs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sems can btags pa'i sbyod yul can/ /nas/ shes bar bya ba bsgrags pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ spang bya rdzas su 'dzin par byed pa dang por gnas pa de ltar shes par bya ba mdo las bsgrags pa gang yin pa'i sgom spang rdzas 'dzin rtogs pa chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ sems can du btags pa'i spyod yul so skye la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin du phung sogs kyi chos su btags pa tsam gyis gang zag la dang*/ tha snyad du yod pas stong pa ma yin pa nyid kyi mkhyen gsum sgom pa'i gang zag la dang*/ dmigs pa la bden par chags pa'i skye bo la dang*/ gnas lugs kyi don rab tu 'byed pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang sems la dang*/ dman pa'i mya 'das kyi dngos po thob byar byed pa'i nyan rang 'phags pa la dang*/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung ba'i byang sems la dang*/ sbyin bdag gi yon gyi dag pa ma yin pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa la dang*/ phyin drug gi spyod pa rnam par 'khrug pa'i nyan thos tshogs lam pa la dmigs nas longs spyod du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin rnams su yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ sems can btags dang de rgyu yi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis mdor bstan nas/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen nyid/ /nas/ rnam par rtog pa tha mar bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gyis rgyas par bshad la/ dang po'i don ni/ sems can du tha snyad du btags pa dang tha snyad de 'dogs pa'i rgyu yi phung po la bden par zhen pa'i yul can gzhan sgom spang btags 'dzin rtog ba chos can/ theg chen gyi sgom pa'i de yis rnam par 'joms pas sgom pa'i lam de dang 'brel ba yi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam pa dgu yod de/ dmigs yul gyi dbye bas de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa'i don ni/ rtog pa de chos can/ khyod la dgu yod de/ rang gi dmigs pa'i bdag nyid ji bzhin du gzhi shes sogs kun mkhyen ni rnam pa gsum gyi sgrim pa rnam pa gsum spong pa'i skyes bu la dmigs longs spyod pa por bden par 'dzin pa'i rmongs pa gsum dang*/ de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad zhi ba'i lam la rmongs pa dang*/ chos nyid kyi de bzhin nyid la sogs pa dang chos can gzugs sogs mtshungs par ldan pa ngo bo gcig pa dang mi ldan pa ngo bo tha dad pa la dang*/ theg pa che chung gi lam mi mnyam pa la dang*/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa bden bzhi'i chos nyid la dang*/ nyon mongs rnams glo bur ba nyid kyi rang bzhin la dang*/ gzung 'dzin rjas tha dad pa'i gnyis su med pa'i de kho na nyid la kun tu rmongs pa'i skyes bu la dmigs nas longs sbyod pa por bden par rnam bar rtog pa tha mar bzhed pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa ni rtog pa lhan skyes kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin te/ sgom spangs kyi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzung rtog dang 'dzin rtog tu 'jog tshul gyi khyad par ni sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ gsum pa phan yon ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni/ /nas/ rnams pa kun tu bsten par byed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/

don ni/ theg pa chen po'i spangs rtogs kyi 'bras bu mchog gis spa ba ste mdzes pa yi sgom lam chen po'i chen po la gnas pa'i sems dpa' chen po de chos can/ khyod la ni theg pa gsum gyi spang rtogs kyi yon tan gyi rigs phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed de/ nad pa nad las grol nas yun ring lon nas dga' bas dbugs phyin pa ltar mi bzad pa'i yams nad dang 'dra ba'i sgom spangs chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs spang bya 'di rnams zad nas ni rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi sgrib gnyis kyi nad sel bar byed pa'i spang ba'i yon tan dang*/ rgya mtsho che la chu bo 'du ba bzhin du theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs rnams ngang gis 'du bas 'gro ba'i bde ba ma lus pa sgrub par byed pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor bshad pa la/ dngos kyi don dang*/ log rtog bsal ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon te bstan pa dang*/ dmigs rnam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang*/ nas/ de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ mdo las stong gsum kyi skye bo rnams nyan thos dang bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' skyon med pa'i sa dang po la bkod pa'i dge ba rnams bsod nams che ba dper mdzad nas de bas kyang bsod nams ches mang po nyid kyis ni mtshon te bstan pa'i rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi ye shes rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid bar chad med lam du dngos su skyed par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ /nas/ /rab tu smra rnams rgyud mar rgol/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/

don ni/ bden grub kyi dngos po med pa de chos can/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor 'di yi dmigs pa yin te/ de'i sgro 'dogs gcad gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ rgyun mtha'i sbyor ba'i dus kyi dran pa theg chen sems bskyed chos can/ rtse sbyor de'i bdag po'i rkyen yin par bzhed de/ de rang dbang du dngos su bskyed par byed pa'i sems pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor chos can/ rnam pa zhi ba nyid yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas gnyis snang gi spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i sems dpa'i rnam 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam 'di chos can/ shin tu zab pa yin te/ khyod la ni bden gnyis ngo bo 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i dbang gis rtsod pa rab tu sma ba rnams kyis rgyud mar rgol bar 'byung yang klan ka'i gnas ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa log rtog bsal pa ni/ dmigs pa 'thad dad de yi ni/ /nas/ rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ rnam pa kun mkhyen pa nyid dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnams la brten pa can gyi bden gnyis ngo bo gcig tu 'du mi rung bar 'gal bar smra ba rnams kyis log par rtog pa chos can/ rnam pa bcu drug dag tu bzhed de/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de'i dmigs pa 'thad pa la mi 'thad do snyam du log par rtog pa dang*/ de bzhin du dmigs pa de yi ni ngo bo nyid bden stong du nges par bzung ba la dang*/ 'bras bu rnam kun mkhyen nyid kyi ye shes la dang*/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i don dang kun rdzob kyi bden pa gnyis la dang*/ spyod pa zhi lhag zung 'brel kyi rnal 'byor ba dang*/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum so so la dang*/ thabs la mkhas dang bcas pa la dang*/ thub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la dang*/ rtag 'dzin sogs phyin ci log bzhi dang ni de dag spong bar byed pa'i lam dang bcas pa gnyis pa la dang*/

gnyen po ye shes dang spang bya mi mthun phyogs dag la dang*/ sgom bya dang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang de sgom pa gnyis la log par rtog pa gnyis rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ log rtog rnams kyi kun nas bslangs pa'i sun 'phyin de la gnyis yod de/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka dang don dam sgo can gyi klan ka gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ dbu ma pa'i kun rdzob kyi khas len rtags su bkod nas don dam sun 'byin pa'i sun 'byin de/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka dang*/ dbu ma pa'i don dam gyi khas len rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa'i sun 'byin de/ don dam sgo can gyi klan ka yin pa'i phyir/ dang po ni/ dngos smra bas dbu ma pa la sa bon gyis myu gu bskyed pa mi 'thad par thal/ sa myug kun rdzob tu grub pa'i phyir zhes 'phangs pa'i sun 'byin lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam mi 'thad par thal/ chos thams cad don dam par grub pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mthar gyis sbyor ba ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed/ /ces pa'i bar gsungs/ don ni/ shes bya chos can/ mthar gyis pa yi bya bar bzhed pa bcu gsum yod de/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi mthar gyis bar drug dag dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa ste chos dge 'dun tshul khrims gtong ba lha rjes su dran pa drug dang*/ chos thams cad don dam par dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa nyid kyi ni dbye bas mthar gyis sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ mthar gyis sbyor ba'i don yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam par brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bsgom pa'i tshe chos bcu gsum po des zin pa'i sgo nas go rim ma 'chol bar sgom par byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/

/bzhi pa skad cig sbyor ba bshad pa la/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig sbyor ba/ rnam par smin pa'i/ mtshan nyid med pa'i/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor ba dang bzhi/ dang po la dngos dang*/ dpe gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re res kyang*/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam la gnas pa'i thub pa'i rgyud kyi rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi lam gyi rigs rnams mngon du byed pa'i sbyor ba 'di ni chos can/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i skad cig ma gcig pa yi rtogs pa yin par shes bya ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phyin drug re res kyang rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi chos kyi rigs kun bsdus nas mngon du byed pa'i sems dpa'i sbyor ba mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dpe ni/ ji ltar skyes bu zo chun rgyud/ /zhes sogs rkang ba bzhi/ don ni/ rgyud mtha'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis zag med kyi ye shes thams cad shes nus pa thob pa yin te/ ji ltar te dper na zo chun gyi rgyud gcig skyes bus rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na rgyud thams cad cig char 'gul ba ltar dpe tshul de bzhin du shes nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnam par smin pa ni/ gang tshe chos dkar thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi/ don ni/ sgrib gnyis kyi dngos gnyen bar chad med lam sgom pa gang gi tshe dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i chos dkar po thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zag med rnam par smin pa'i chos nyid kyi gnas skabs rgyun mtha'i ye shes skyes pa de'i tshe rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam chos can/ zag med kyi chos thams cad skad cig ma gcig gis mngon du byed nus pa yin te/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa ni/

sbyin pa la sogs spyod pa yis/ /zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam chos can/ mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ kun byang gi chos rnams don dam par mtshan nyid med pa nyid du dus skad cig ma gcig gis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin drug gi spyod pa yis chos kun snang la rang bzhin med pa rmi lam dang 'dra bar rtogs pa la gnas nas goms pa'i sems dpa'i rnam 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor pa ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi gsungs/ don ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med laṃ chos can/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos rnams rdzas tha dad kyis stong pa gnyis su med pa yi de nyid skad cig ma gcig gis mngon sum du mthong nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rmi laṃ gyi ri rab khang khyim sogs dang ni de mthong pa'i sad pa'i shes pa nyid rdzas tha dad pa gnyis kyi tshul du mi mthong ba ltar ro/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bzhi po ni 'gal ba ma yin te/ gzhi gcig byed las tha dad pa'i sgo nas bzhag pas ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir te/ rtsa bar mtshan nyid kyis ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ces pa 'di nyid kyang bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skabs lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum gyi ṭīk+ka mthong ba don yod ces bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 192--PAGE 191--PAGE 171-
